mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 61 degrees near Verona Area High School.

The City of Verona has announced that public works will begin using a new leaf vacuum truck this fall. Please remember to place loose leaves behind the curb for collection. Additionally, the city has updated permit guidelines for solar installations and detached garages.

Today you can head over to Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, tomorrow features trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, and on Tuesday, you can enjoy the Farmer's Market or trivia at Paddy Mac's.
In the weekly report for September 28 through October 5, officers responded to an incident on October 3 where a 19-year-old was arrested for possession of a stolen firearm.
Today's flavor at Culver's is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is open until 10:00 PM, so stop by and grab a scoop while you can.
